name: top.plainly/plainly
title: Plainly TOP
description: Plainly TOP — AI shopping consultant comparing product offers by total price, delivery, and trust.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Find the best current offers for any product across marketplaces available in Ukraine: electronics, clothing and footwear, home and garden, beauty and health, children's products, sports and leisure, auto and more. Ranked by total price with delivery, delivery time and seller trust. Use whenever the user wants to buy a product or compare prices.

query.description: Product, brand, features, or shopper needs.

category.description: Optional product category; electronics also covers legacy phone, watch, audio, tablet and accessory filters.

budget_max.description: Maximum total including delivery, in the selected currency.

limit.description: Maximum number of offers, from 1 to 6.

tools.name: get_offer_details
tools.description: Get full specifications, seller information, delivery, total price, the reason for recommendation, and source link for one offer returned by search_offers.

offer_id.description: The exact id returned by search_offers.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compare two to four offers side by side using total price with delivery, delivery time, seller trust, and specifications. Returns a one-line verdict with the best overall offer.

offer_ids.description: Two to four distinct ids returned by search_offers.

tools.name: get_offer_link
tools.description: Get the seller's affiliate link for an offer. Optionally pass a blogger or publisher reference to include it as the sub_id URL parameter; always show the affiliate disclosure.

offer_id.description: The exact id returned by search_offers.

ref.description: Optional blogger or publisher id; letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only.

tools.name: find_local_alternative
tools.description: Find the same product model and memory/variant from a Ukrainian store, with local price, 1–3 day delivery, warranty, price difference, and source link. Provide an offer_id from search_offers or a normalized product model.

offer_id.description: An exact id returned by search_offers; preferred when available.

model.description: Product model, optionally with RAM/storage variant, used when offer_id is unavailable.

currency.description: Currency for the local price and price difference.
